**Links that open the right thing, and BookOrbit audiobooks where they belong**

- **Book links open the book.** In BookOrbit, BookLore and Grimmory, each book in a newsletter now links to its own page, not the library's front page.
- **BookOrbit audiobooks show as audiobooks,** under Audiobooks. MOBI, AZW3 and FB2 books are labelled **Ebook**, CB7 comics **Comic**, and an item with both an ebook and audio **Ebook + audio**.
- **Plex links through app.plex.tv** go straight to Plex's own address, so the item isn't lost when Plex asks people to sign in. Tautulli sources get a clearer **Public URL** hint, and the OPDS hint now says to use an OPDS account, not your normal sign-in.
- **Backup errors link to the fix,** on latestarr.app.

Thanks to [@crispybegs](https://github.com/crispybegs) for testing so thoroughly and reporting most of these in [#353](https://github.com/jshields-ca/LatestArr/issues/353).
